# google_kms_google_kms_autokey_config

Reads the KMS AutokeyConfig for a folder or project.




## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:



* `folder` -
  (Optional)
  The folder, in the format `folders/{{folder_id}}`

* `project` -
  (Optional)
  The project, in the format `projects/{{project_id}}`



## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{name}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name for the `AutokeyConfig` in the format `folders/{{folder_id}}/autokeyConfig` or `projects/{{project_id}}/autokeyConfig`.

* `key_project` -
  The key project to use for this folder. This should be in the format `projects/{{project_id}}`.

* `key_project_resolution_mode` -
  How to resolve the project used for key provisioning.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


google_kms_autokey_config can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `{{parent}}/autokeyConfig/{{name}}`
* `{{parent}}/{{name}}`


In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import google_kms_autokey_config using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "{{parent}}/autokeyConfig/{{name}}"
  to = google_kms_google_kms_autokey_config.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), google_kms_autokey_config can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_kms_google_kms_autokey_config.default {{parent}}/autokeyConfig/{{name}}
$ terraform import google_kms_google_kms_autokey_config.default {{parent}}/{{name}}
```
